## Description

<!-- SECTION:DESCRIPTION:BEGIN -->
User-selected useful mission: create one readable, source-cited status brief through DEMA and existing governed runtime owners. Current work is architectural specification only. Written design and implementation-plan reviews precede source implementation; an exact separate execution grant precedes the real mission. Preserve STOP_AFTER_D2 and do not claim preview evidence as execution, usefulness or Node0 closure.
<!-- SECTION:DESCRIPTION:END -->

## Acceptance Criteria
<!-- AC:BEGIN -->
- [ ] #1 Written design identifies existing source, consent, writer, receipt and recovery owners and exposes missing admission paths
- [ ] #2 Every material claim is source-bound and historical observations are not presented as current runtime liveness
- [ ] #3 Approved report and source snapshot digests, destination and operational metadata writes are bound by exact consent
- [ ] #4 One authorized report is independently observed, its runtime receipt verifies, and recovery cannot duplicate the report
- [ ] #5 Human usefulness is recorded separately; no simulation or test success mints impact or Node0 closure
<!-- AC:END -->
